per_event.why: Both clips show the ship moving horizontally across the lane, changing directions, and entering focus mode (indicated by the circular ring around a black core dot, e.g., X at 06.6-08.8s and Y at 05.8-08.8s) with identical visual clarity.
Neither clip shows single tap shots; both clips only show charged arc shots being released after resting.

When enemies are hit by the charged arc (X at 08.0s, Y at 06.8-08.5s), Y adds clear floating 'PETAL' labels next to the disarmed enemies and a 'Codex: Scout' popup, making the disarm state much clearer than in X.
In both clips, resting charges the weapon up to level 3, shown identically by the cyan arc indicator in front of the ship and the CANNON meter at the top right.
Both clips show wide cyan arc shots missing (X at 01.0s, 02.0s; Y at 00.2s, 01.0s, 02.0s) and hitting (X at 08.0s; Y at 06.8s) with the same visual and audio feedback.
No shots bouncing off armor are present in either clip.
No boss is present in either clip.

When the player loses a life (X at 05.4s, Y at 04.6s and 09.8s), both play a loud crash sound and expand a ring from the ship, but X also flashes a red vignette around the screen border (05.5-06.5s), making the damage event much more unmistakable.
Neither clip shows a complex multi-hit situation where distinguishing simultaneous hit outcomes is tested.

clutter.issue: Large 'SECTOR 1 Outer Drift' title text overlays the upper-middle combat lane right where the first wave of enemies and bullets appear (00.0-01.0s).
Scrolling vertical dashed lane lines and orange dots on the floor add visual noise behind small pink bullets throughout the clip.
The 'Codex: Scout' banner (06.0-09.5s) and floating 'PETAL' tags on enemies (06.5-10.5s) sit directly in the combat lane alongside enemy ships and bullets.

overall.why: Clip Y has a clean, solid dark blue playfield without the scrolling dashed lines and orange floor dots seen in X, and it avoids blocking the initial enemy wave with large sector title text. Although X has a better red screen-border flash when losing a life, Y's cleaner background makes enemy bullets and ships easier to track overall.
